item: Living sources backup: maps store carried and merged country by country (R739)
summary: osm.db rides the encrypted backup; on import a finished country this machine lacks is copied whole in one transaction after reader checks and its indexes rebuilt; a country both hold keeps the local copy and a newer backup copy is reported; unfinished never copied; re-import no-op; first daily update applies from the copied cursor; a backup carrying a lane credits its source (OSM + ODbL per Q823).
